reasoning: Equal butter and flour requirements give (4x+1)/6=(13x+5)/20. Cross-multiplying yields 80x+20=78x+30, so 2x=10 and x=5. The earlier answer 5 was graded Correct and agrees with Math Academy's worked solution.

answers.ma_evidence: Thus, $x=5$ cakes are produced when the pastry shop uses the same number of packs of butter and flour.
